### Verdict

**Request Changes (Blocking Findings Present).**  
The overall architecture—lease-counted `Scope`s, dedicated native owner threads for `Runtime` teardown (`GroupInner`), generation-guarded registry entries, and `Tracked` / `BlockingWork` helper wrappers—is well-structured and preserves unmanaged `.start()` behavior. However, there are **4 blocking lifecycle/supervision bugs** (and several medium/low issues) affecting startup failure handling, `ActorRef::ready()` panic reporting, reverse-shutdown ordering across `ActorSystem`, and retry-budget/backoff ordering.

---

### Severity-Ranked Actionable Findings

#### 1. [BLOCKER / High] Pre-ready actor exits leave `exit = None` in `run_child`, misclassifying `Transient` normal exits as abnormal and dropping `last_exit`
* **Location:** [concurrency/src/supervision.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L425-L485)
* **Mechanism:**  
  In [`run_child`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L425-L468), `exit` is only populated inside the `Ok(actor)` branch when `published` is `true` (where `ready_at` is also set to `Some(Instant::now())` at line 444). Whenever an actor stops or panics inside `started(&ctx)` (or when `startup_timeout` expires or `published` is `false`), `actor.ready().await` returns `Err(SystemError::StartupFailed(reason))`, so `began` is `Err(...)`, `ready_at` is `None`, and **`exit` remains `None`**.
  * At [line 470](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L470), `v.snapshot.last_exit = exit.clone()` overwrites `last_exit` with `None`, even when the child spawned and exited with `ExitReason::Panic(...)` or `ExitReason::Normal` during `started()`.
  * At [lines 481-484](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L481-L484):
    ```rust
    if !spec.restart.restarts(exit.as_ref()) {
        if ready_at.is_none() { core.fail(format!("non-restartable child failed startup: {}", spec.name)); }
        break;
    }
    ```
    Because `exit` is always `None` when `ready_at.is_none()`, [`RestartMode::Transient::restarts(None)`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L17) evaluates `reason.map(ExitReason::is_abnormal).unwrap_or(true)` to `true`. A `Transient` child that intentionally calls `ctx.stop()` (`ExitReason::Normal`) during `started()` is treated as an abnormal crash and endlessly restarted until the shared retry budget is exhausted, instead of hitting the `non-restartable child failed startup` failure path on line 482.
* **Fix:** After `scope.joined().await` completes (or when `began` fails after `scope.attach`), populate `exit = exit.or_else(|| scope.child().and_then(|c| c.exit_reason()))` and `v.snapshot.actor_id = v.snapshot.actor_id.or_else(|| scope.child().map(|c| c.id()))`, then update `v.snapshot.last_exit = exit.clone()`.

---

#### 2. [BLOCKER / High] `Scope::wait_ready` races `self.token.cancelled()` against `scope.exited()`, misreporting `started()` / `stopped()` panics as `ExitReason::Kill` or `ExitReason::Normal`
* **Location:** [concurrency/src/system.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L334-L355), [concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L926-L930), [concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L1095-L1113)
* **Mechanism:**  
  1. When a managed actor panics in `started(&ctx)`, [`run_actor_lifecycle`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L1098) immediately calls `cancellation_token.cancel()` (which is `scope.token`) **before** `run_actor` drains the receiver, before [`cleanup.complete(reason)`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L926) (which also cancels `cleanup_token`), and before [`scope.exited(actual)`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L929) sets `scope.cause` and `scope.ready`.
  2. Concurrently, any caller awaiting `actor.ready().await` ([`Scope::wait_ready`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L343)) wakes immediately on the `Either::Left(_)` (`self.token.cancelled()`) branch while `ready` is still `StartupState::Pending` and `self.cause` is still `None`, returning `Err(SystemError::StartupFailed(ExitReason::Kill))` instead of `ExitReason::Panic(...)`.
  3. Similarly, if an actor calls `ctx.stop()` in `started()` (setting `scope.cause = Some(ExitReason::Normal)` and cancelling `scope.token`) and then panics in `started()` or `stopped()`, `wait_ready()` already returned early on `self.token.cancelled()` with `ExitReason::Normal`, and [line 928 of `tasks/actor.rs`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L928):
     ```rust
     let actual = crate::system::lock(&scope.cause).clone().unwrap_or(reason);
     ```
     prefers the earlier `scope.cause` (`Normal` or `Shutdown`) over an abnormal `reason` (`ExitReason::Panic(...)` from `started()` or `stopped()`).
* **Fix:**
  * In [`tasks/actor.rs:928`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L928), preserve abnormal exit reasons (e.g., `let actual = if reason.is_abnormal() { reason } else { crate::system::lock(&scope.cause).clone().unwrap_or(reason) };`).
  * In [`Scope::wait_ready`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L334-L355), do not return early on `self.token.cancelled()` while `StartupState::Pending`; wait for `ready.changed()` (which is guaranteed to be signaled by `mark_ready()`, `exited()`, or `Lease::drop` once the root lease drops).

---

#### 3. [BLOCKER / High] `ActorSystem` shutdown breaks reverse shutdown order across supervisors/actors and stalls all earlier standalone actors if a later unit or actor hangs
* **Location:** [concurrency/src/system.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L165-L195), [concurrency/src/supervision.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L234-L255)
* **Mechanism:**  
  1. **Simultaneous supervisor shutdown:** In [`SystemInner::begin_shutdown`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L172), `for unit in &units { unit.close(); }` runs synchronously for all supervisors before spawning the shutdown coordinator. However, [`Core::close`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L234-L239) calls `self.cancel.cancel()`, which is the signal that wakes [`run_supervisor`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L362) to begin stopping children. Consequently, all supervisors start stopping their children **in parallel** at line 172 rather than waiting for `for unit in units.iter().rev() { unit.stop_and_wait().await; }` at line 182.
  2. **Ordering between supervisors and standalone actors:** All `units` are stopped before any standalone `scope` in `scopes` ([lines 182-188](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L182-L188)), even if a standalone actor was admitted via `start_on` *after* an earlier supervisor and depends on that supervisor's children.
  3. **Unbounded wait blocks subsequent shutdown signals:** In [`run_supervisor`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L369-L372), `core.done` is not set until `for task in tasks { task.await }` finishes, and [`run_child`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L462-L474) awaits `child.wait_exit_async()` and `scope.joined()` without a bound after recording `core.fail(...)`. In [`begin_shutdown`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L182-L188), `unit.stop_and_wait().await` and `scope.joined().await` also have no timeout. Thus, if a single supervised child or standalone actor has a stuck `spawn_blocking_helper` or `stopped()` hook, `begin_shutdown` blocks forever on that item and **never even sends `ExitReason::Shutdown`** to earlier standalone scopes in `scopes.iter().rev()`.
* **Fix:**
  * Separate admission closure (`gate.close()` + `child.close_admission()`) in `ShutdownUnit::close()` from actual shutdown initiation (`cancel.cancel()`) in `ShutdownUnit::stop_and_wait()`.
  * In `run_supervisor`, notify a "shutdown sequence finished" watch channel once the `children.iter().rev()` timeout loop finishes (while still holding `core.done` for full cleanup completion), or bound the per-scope wait in `begin_shutdown` before signalling earlier units/scopes.
  * Order shutdown units and standalone scopes by a shared monotonic admission sequence ID.

---

#### 4. [BLOCKER / High] `run_child` sleeps for backoff *before* checking `core.retry()`, aging out the rolling `restart_window` during backoff and delaying failure when budget is exhausted
* **Location:** [concurrency/src/supervision.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L213-L220), [concurrency/src/supervision.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L386-L395)
* **Mechanism:**  
  In [`run_child`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L386-L395):
  ```rust
  if !first {
      let delay = core.config.backoff.delay(failures, &mut rng);
      failures = failures.saturating_add(1);
      view.change(|v| v.snapshot.state = ChildState::Backoff);
      if matches!(select(Box::pin(core.cancel.cancelled()), Box::pin(rt::sleep(delay))).await, Either::Left(_)) { break; }
      if !core.retry() {
          if core.gate.is_open() { core.fail(format!("restart budget exhausted by {}", spec.name)); }
          break;
      }
  }
  ```
  1. When `max_restarts == 0` (or when the rolling retry budget is already exhausted at the moment of crash), the child still transitions to `ChildState::Backoff` and sleeps for `delay` (up to `backoff.maximum`) before checking `core.retry()` and failing the supervisor.
  2. Because `core.retry()` stamps `Instant::now()` *after* sleeping for `delay`, backoff time is counted toward aging out prior attempts in `restart_window`. Whenever accumulated backoff delays exceed `restart_window / max_restarts`, earlier attempts age out while the child is sleeping in `Backoff`, allowing a crashing child to loop forever without ever exhausting the retry budget.
* **Fix:** Check `if !core.retry()` immediately when deciding to restart (before sleeping in `ChildState::Backoff`).

---

#### 5. [Medium] `SupervisedChild::wait_for_generation` can hang on supervisor stop/failure or return `ChildUnavailable(ChildState::Running)`
* **Location:** [concurrency/src/supervision.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L169-L182), [concurrency/src/supervision.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L234-L245)
* **Mechanism:**  
  * [`Core::close`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L234-L239) closes `self.gate` and cancels `self.cancel`, but does **not** notify `view.changed`. A caller parked in [`wait_for_generation`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L180) on Child 0 will remain blocked at `changes.changed().await` while later children (Child 1, ...) are still running their shutdown timeouts.
  * If `wait_for_generation` is called (or woken) after `self.view.gate` closes while Child 0 is still waiting for its reverse-order `stop_turn`, `snapshot.state` is still `ChildState::Running`, so [line 178](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L178) returns `Err(ChildUnavailable(ChildState::Running))` (`"child is not currently ready: Running"`), unlike `current()` which returns `ChildUnavailable(ChildState::Stopping)`.
* **Fix:** Notify `view.changed` in `ChildControl::close_admission()` (or select on `core.cancel.cancelled()` in `wait_for_generation`), and return `ChildState::Stopping` when `!self.view.gate.is_open()` and `snapshot.state` is not yet `Stopped`/`Failed`.

---

#### 6. [Medium] `ShutdownReport` can list the same `ActorId` in both `unfinished_actors` and `exits`, and `SupervisorBuilder::add` does not validate `ExecutionGroup` ownership
* **Location:** [concurrency/src/system.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L216-L221), [concurrency/src/supervision.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L285-L301)
* **Mechanism:**  
  * In [`ShutdownReport::wait`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/system.rs#L216-L221), `unfinished_actors` includes any scope where `!*s.done.borrow()` (which stays `false` while a `spawn_blocking_helper` is still running even after the actor itself has exited), while `exits` includes any scope where `s.child()?.exit_reason()` is `Some(_)`. Thus an actor whose `stopped()` finished but whose blocking helper is still running appears in **both** `unfinished_actors` and `exits`.
  * [`SupervisorBuilder::add`](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/supervision.rs#L285) does not verify that `spec.group` belongs to the same `ActorSystem` (`self.owner`). A child placed on another `ActorSystem`'s `ExecutionGroup` is invisible to the supervisor's owning `ActorSystem::shutdown` scope tracking (`shutdown_scopes`).
* **Fix:** Store the owning system identity on `GroupInner` and check it in `SupervisorBuilder::add`; in `ShutdownReport::wait`, either filter `unfinished_actors` by `c.is_alive()` (or document that `unfinished_actors` tracks unfinished actor scopes including post-exit helpers).

---

#### 7. [Low] `Drop` panic of actor state `A` or queued messages in `run_actor` bypasses `catch_unwind`
* **Location:** [concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L1064-L1081), [concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs](file:///Users/unbalancedparen/projects/federicocarrone.com/concurrency/src/tasks/actor.rs#L1190-L1191)
* **Mechanism:**  
  `started()`, `handle()`, and `stopped()` are wrapped in `catch_unwind`, but `mut actor: A` is dropped outside `catch_unwind` at the end of `run_actor_lifecycle` (line 1191), and queued envelopes are dropped outside `catch_unwind` during `while rx.recv().await.is_some() {}` (line 1079). If `A::drop` or a queued message's `Drop` panics, `inner_future` unwinds before `cleanup.complete(reason)` and `scope.exited(actual)`, causing `ActorCleanup::drop` to report `ExitReason::Kill` instead of `ExitReason::Panic`.
* **Fix:** Drop `actor` inside `catch_unwind` after `stopped()` and wrap the mailbox drain in `catch_unwind`.
